description: Convx 1.5.3-beta-r12 delivers targeted visual refinements, landscape ergonomics optimizations, and critical layout engine stability fixes across lyrics sharing and search navigation.

changelog.title: Search & Liquid Glass Interface
items: Restored real-time liquid glass refraction, chromatic aberration, and spring physics for the category pill indicator on the Search screen.
Corrected visual layer composition to ensure the active indicator renders with full optical depth across all display scales.

changelog.title: Lyrics & Player Ergonomics
items: Optimized menu button hierarchy: the secondary track action menu is now reserved exclusively for landscape view, eliminating duplicate controls in vertical portrait mode.
Refined layout spacing and gesture response for full-screen lyrics viewing.

changelog.title: Lyrics Sharing Stability
items: Fixed a critical layout padding assertion error (IllegalArgumentException: Padding must be non-negative) during lyric quote card generation.
Enhanced constraint bounds handling to ensure robust social card exports on high-density devices and One UI configurations.

changelog.title: Performance & Architecture
items: Preserved high-speed direct CDN asset distribution for rapid in-app beta updates.
Ongoing performance improvements for low-latency audio playback and backdrop rendering.
